##### Project general facts

The Hillgate by Ellington Properties is a contemporary residential development located in Dubai Silicon Oasis, offering a curated selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments designed with a strong focus on space, light, and modern functionality. The architecture follows Ellington’s signature aesthetic, combining clean lines, refined proportions, and thoughtfully integrated glazing that enhances natural illumination throughout the interiors. Each residence is carefully planned to balance privacy and openness, creating a calm and elegant living environment suited for both families and professionals.

The lifestyle at The Hillgate is supported by a well-rounded collection of amenities designed to promote wellness, recreation, and community interaction. Residents have access to a fully equipped gym, swimming pools for adults and children, and dedicated wellness spaces including a Yoga and Pilates studio. Social areas such as the clubhouse and BBQ zone encourage gathering and connection, while landscaped outdoor spaces and a dedicated kids’ play area ensure a family-friendly atmosphere within a safe and engaging environment.

Interiors are finished with modern, high-quality materials that emphasize simplicity, comfort, and refined detailing. Kitchens are designed as functional focal points, featuring sleek finishes, ample storage, and a central island that integrates seamlessly with the living and dining areas. Residences are offered unfurnished, allowing homeowners to personalize their spaces, while the overall design language ensures a cohesive foundation of elegance, practicality, and contemporary style.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Silicon Oasis is a cutting-edge technology park and residential community located in Dubai. It spans over 7.2 square kilometres and is strategically situated on the Emirates Road, providing easy access to Dubai's major highways and landmarks.

As a hub for technology and innovation, Dubai Silicon Oasis is home to numerous multinational technology companies, startups, and research institutions. It offers state-of-the-art infrastructure and facilities tailored to the needs of the tech industry, including advanced telecommunications, data centres, and modern office spaces.

In addition to its technological prowess, Dubai Silicon Oasis is also a vibrant residential community. Residents enjoy a plethora of amenities, such as schools, healthcare facilities, shopping malls, parks, and recreational areas, creating a well-rounded and convenient lifestyle.
